FOUNDRY_RIVE.SourceHint: A path to an uploaded .riv.json file or a URL to a .riv file. Use the upload button to add a .riv file from your computer.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.AspectRatioHint: auto matches the artboard. Or give width / height, for example 16 / 9 or 1.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.Caption: Caption
FOUNDRY_RIVE.NoSource: Choose or upload a Rive file to preview it here.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.NoState: This file's state machine has no inputs, and it has no view model properties.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TileHint: Play a Rive animation on this tile. The tile's image stays underneath as a fallback for anyone without the module.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TileNotLoaded: This tile's Rive file hasn't loaded yet.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TokenHint: Play a Rive animation as this token's image. The token's normal image stays underneath as a fallback for anyone without the module. In bindings, @actor means this token's own actor (linked or not) and @token the token itself; a path of status:prone (or any condition) is true while it applies.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TokenRingWarning: This token uses a dynamic token ring. Rive isn't drawn on ring tokens yet; turn the ring off in the Appearance tab to use Rive.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TokenLiveHint: Changes here play on this token for everyone viewing the scene right now. They aren't saved unless you save them as defaults.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TileLiveHint: Changes here play on this tile for everyone viewing the scene right now. They aren't saved unless you save them as defaults.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.TileSourceHint: An uploaded .riv.json file or a URL to a .riv file. Leave empty to turn Rive off for this tile.

TileFps.Name: Rive tile frame rate
TileFps.Hint: How often animated Rive tiles and tokens update on this computer. Lower it if scenes with many Rive tiles feel slow.

MaxPlayers.Name: Maximum Rive players
MaxPlayers.Hint: How many Rive animations can play at once on this computer, across journals, chat, tiles and tokens. Beyond this, new ones show an error instead of loading.

FOUNDRY_RIVE.LiveHint: Changes here play for everyone viewing this page right now. They aren't saved unless you save them as defaults.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.LiveSaved: Saved the live values as this page's defaults.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.BindUuid: Drop a document, paste its UUID, or @actor / @token
FOUNDRY_RIVE.LiveBoundHidden: Bound values aren't shown here; they follow their data.
FOUNDRY_RIVE.LiveAllBound: Every value in this file is bound to data, so there's nothing to change live.

Matt.Name: Name
Matt.NameHelp: The property or input name, as listed on the Rive tab of the tile or token.
Matt.FireHelp: A trigger property or trigger input, as listed on the Rive tab of the tile or token.
Matt.ValueHelp: Text, a number, true/false, a color, or an enum option. {{token.name}}-style values and [[1d6]] rolls work too. Bound properties are skipped.
Matt.RememberHelp: Also save the value as the default, so it stays after a reload. Otherwise it lasts until the last GM leaves.
Matt.VariableHelp: Name to store the value under (default: the Rive name). Later actions read it as rive.<name>, for example Check value with rive.sprung, or {{value.rive.sprung}}. Compare text in quotes ("Open"); for true/false, check true and use the fail landing for false.
Matt.GetText: Get Rive {name} from {entity} as {variable}
